name: Mercury Engineering
industry_role: Irish MEP and prime contractor with dedicated Hyperscale and Enterprise data-centre divisions
description: Dublin contractor, founded in 1972 as an electrical contractor, for which data centres are reported as about two-thirds of revenue; named construction partner to Global Technical Realty in 2020 and prime contractor on GTR's 40.5 MW GB One campus near London.
notes: A 'EUR 2.2bn' GTR programme figure appears in one article but could not be confirmed; not used. Added 2026-10-30 from open-source research (import_researched_companies.py).
